scripts.check: calcit calcit.cirru --check-only --all-defs && calcit calcit.cirru fix --workflow strict --verify --format json | jq -e '.data.workflow.status == "passed" and .diagnostics == []' && calcit calcit.cirru analyze weak-types --only deprecated-call --summary-only --format json | jq -e '.data.summary.calls == 0' && yarn check:weak-types
scripts.build: yarn compile && yarn test && vite build
scripts.check:weak-types: calcit analyze weak-types --only coverage --coverage-level none,partial --format json | jq -e '.data.definitions | length == 0' && calcit analyze weak-types --only schema-dynamic,unresolved-type-slot,code-dynamic,code-nil,unsafe-coerce,data-dynamic --format json | jq -e 'all(.data.definitions[]; .id == "app.schema/Store" and (.occurrences | length <= 1 and all(.[]; .kind == "data-dynamic")))'
